name: Seren
source:
You remember your wretched past: the death of your soldier parents, your childhood on the streets, your harsh training for a war that ended before you could ever fight in it. The first eighteen years of your life were a constant struggle to survive. Five years later, you're rich, famous and confused.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/theherosjourney]itch.io[/url]]
